 Experience a Scenic and Peaceful Ride Along Lake Michigan
New to Door County, these quad bike rentals are fun memory-makers. Choose a two- or four-person quad bike (max. four adults with two small kids) for an outing that’s fun for the whole family! Enjoy a fun afternoon as you explore Lake Michigan on these shaded bikes.

What is a Quad Bike?
A quad bike is a four-wheeled, human-powered land vehicle. It is also referred to as a surrey bike, quadricycle, quadcycle, pedal car, or four-wheeled bicycle. Human-powered quad bikes have been in use since 1853 and have grown into several families of vehicles for a variety of purposes, including tourist rentals, pedal taxis, private touring, mountain, and industrial use. They’re easy to ride and a great way to explore with the family.
